milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the red wool archway and face it to demonstrate they have visually located it. The red wool archway center is at spawn-relative (0, 2, 3). Max distance of 16 blocks and facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is reasonably close and looking toward the wool. Since the player spawns at z=0 facing south (+Z), the archway at z=3 is directly ahead, making this the natural first discovery.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate through the corridor and get close enough to the light gray bed while facing it to demonstrate visual discovery. The bed occupies z=16 (head) and z=17 (foot) at x=0, so the target center is (0, 1, 17). Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player has actually walked through the full corridor to the end room (the bed is ~17 blocks from spawn). Facing tolerance of 60° confirms the player is looking at the bed.
